using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using System;
using Duplicati.Server.Database;

namespace Duplicati.Server.Database.Tests
{
    public class ConnectionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void SignalSettingsChanged_CallsGetRequiredService_EventPollNotify_SignalNewEvent()
        {
            // Arrange
            var serviceProvider = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            var eventPollNotify = new Mock<EventPollNotify>();
            serviceProvider.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<EventPollNotify>())
                          .Returns(eventPollNotify.Object);

            var connection = new Mock<Connection>(
                Mock.Of<IDbConnection>(),
                disableFieldEncryption: false,
                key: null,
                dataFolder: "test",
                startOrStopUsageReporter: () => { }
            ) { CallBase = true };

            connection.Protected().Setup<IServiceProvider?>("ServiceProvider")
                     .Returns(serviceProvider.Object);
            connection.Object.SetServiceProvider(serviceProvider.Object);

            // Act
            connection.Object.SignalSettingsChanged();

            // Assert
            eventPollNotify.Verify(epn => epn.SignalNewEvent(), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void SignalSettingsChanged_CallsGetRequiredService_EventPollNotify_SignalServerSettingsUpdated()
        {
            // Arrange
            var serviceProvider = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            var eventPollNotify = new Mock<EventPollNotify>();
            serviceProvider.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<EventPollNotify>())
                          .Returns(eventPollNotify.Object);

            var connection = new Mock<Connection>(
                Mock.Of<IDbConnection>(),
                disableFieldEncryption: false,
                key: null,
                dataFolder: "test",
                startOrStopUsageReporter: () => { }
            ) { CallBase = true };

            connection.Protected().Setup<IServiceProvider?>("ServiceProvider")
                     .Returns(serviceProvider.Object);
            connection.Object.SetServiceProvider(serviceProvider.Object);

            // Act
            connection.Object.SignalSettingsChanged();

            // Assert
            eventPollNotify.Verify(epn => epn.SignalServerSettingsUpdated(), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void SignalSettingsChanged_ServiceProviderNull_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            var connection = new Mock<Connection>(
                Mock.Of<IDbConnection>(),
                disableFieldEncryption: false,
                key: null,
                dataFolder: "test",
                startOrStopUsageReporter: () => { }
            ) { CallBase = true };

            connection.Protected().Setup<IServiceProvider?>("ServiceProvider")
                     .Returns((IServiceProvider?)null);

            // Act & Assert
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => connection.Object.SignalSettingsChanged());
        }

        [Fact]
        public void SetServiceProvider_NullProvider_SetsFieldsToNull()
        {
            // Arrange
            var connection = new Connection(
                Mock.Of<IDbConnection>(),
                disableFieldEncryption: false,
                key: null,
                dataFolder: "test",
                startOrStopUsageReporter: () => { }
            );

            // Act
            connection.SetServiceProvider(null);

            // Assert - since these are private fields, we test indirectly via ServiceProvider
            Assert.Null(connection.ServiceProvider);
        }
    }
}

using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using System;
using System.Data;
using Duplicati.Server.Database;

namespace Duplicati.Server.Database.Tests
{
    public class ConnectionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void SignalSettingsChanged_WithServiceProvider_CallsEventPollNotifyMethods()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockEventPollNotify = new Mock<EventPollNotify>();
            var mockNotificationService = new Mock<INotificationUpdateService>();
            var mockQueueRunnerService = new Mock<IQueueRunnerService>();
            var mockLiveControls = new Mock<LiveControls>();

            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            services.AddSingleton(mockNotificationService.Object);
            services.AddSingleton(mockEventPollNotify.Object);
            services.AddSingleton(mockQueueRunnerService.Object);
            services.AddSingleton(mockLiveControls.Object);
            
            var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

            var mockDbConnection = Mock.Of<IDbConnection>();
            var connection = new Connection(
                mockDbConnection,
                disableFieldEncryption: false,
                key: null,
                dataFolder: "test-data",
                startOrStopUsageReporter: () => { }
            );

            connection.SetServiceProvider(serviceProvider);

            // Act
            // Use reflection to call the private SignalSettingsChanged method
            typeof(Connection).GetMethod("SignalSettingsChanged", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
                             ?.Invoke(connection, null);

            // Assert - verifies the GetRequiredService<EventPollNotify> calls happened and methods were invoked
            mockEventPollNotify.Verify(epn => epn.SignalNewEvent(), Times.Once);
            mockEventPollNotify.Verify(epn => epn.SignalServerSettingsUpdated(), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void SignalSettingsChanged_ServiceProviderNull_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockDbConnection = Mock.Of<IDbConnection>();
            var connection = new Connection(
                mockDbConnection,
                disableFieldEncryption: false,
                key: null,
                dataFolder: "test-data",
                startOrStopUsageReporter: () => { }
            );

            // Act - use reflection for private method
            var method = typeof(Connection).GetMethod("SignalSettingsChanged", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            
            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(method); // Method exists
            method.Invoke(connection, null); // Should not throw when ServiceProvider is null
        }

        [Fact]
        public void SetServiceProvider_SetsServiceProviderProperty()
        {
            // Arrange
            var serviceProvider = new ServiceCollection().BuildServiceProvider();
            var mockDbConnection = Mock.Of<IDbConnection>();
            var connection = new Connection(
                mockDbConnection,
                disableFieldEncryption: false,
                key: null,
                dataFolder: "test-data",
                startOrStopUsageReporter: () => { }
            );

            // Act
            connection.SetServiceProvider(serviceProvider);

            // Assert - ServiceProvider property is internal, verify via reflection that m_serviceProvider is set
            var field = typeof(Connection).GetField("m_serviceProvider", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            Assert.NotNull(field);
            var actualProvider = field.GetValue(connection) as IServiceProvider;
            Assert.Same(serviceProvider, actualProvider);
        }
    }
}

                mockDbConnection,
                disableFieldEncryption: false,
                key: null,
                dataFolder: "test-data",
                startOrStopUsageReporter: () => { }
            );

            connection.SetServiceProvider(serviceProvider);

            // Act
            SignalSettingsChangedMethod.Invoke(connection, null);

            // Assert
            mockEventPollNotify.Verify(epn => epn.SignalNewEvent(), Times.Once);
            mockEventPollNotify.Verify(epn => epn.SignalServerSettingsUpdated(), Times.Once);

        {

            var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

            var mockDbConnection = Mock.Of<IDbConnection>();

                key: null,
